sloka: न मे दुह्खम् प्रिया दूरे न मे दुह्खम् हृता इति च ।तद् एव अनुशोचामि वयो अस्या हि अतिवर्तते ॥६-५-५॥।।
transliteration: na me duhkham priyā dūre na me duhkham hṛtā iti ca ।tad eva anuśocāmi vayo asyā hi ativartate ॥6-5-5॥।।

translations.english: ﻿ There is no grief in me that my beloved is at a distance, nor that she is taken away. Indeed her age is advancing. On this account I am feeling for her.
